MemeDef.label: embodied abundance
MemeDef.description: A larger body is a visible expression of abundance. Leaders and moral guides are expected to embrace this ideal, while each person's own preferences govern willing assistance. Followers give qualifying larger known adults at least +5 in the body-size component of social opinion. Other causes can still make their total opinion negative. This ideal does not change a follower's fixed social taste or preferred own size.
